theorem.name: QFORM-PHYSICAL-CORE-SPECTRAL-LEAKAGE-GATE-v1
theorem.statement: For selected three large-eigenvalue modes U and every physical I, s3(A[I,I])^2 >= 1-||U_(I^c)||op^2-||A[I,I^c]||op^2.
theorem.concrete_gate: If |I|=m, delta_I<=1/4, and each boundary row l2 norm <=1/(2 sqrt(m)), then ||p_Q||inf<=4 sqrt(3 pi m).

partner_application: Every bounded localization of the newest preserved-pair plus rainbow-E2 physical packet is paid if it captures the selected spectral subspace and has small final-matrix boundary coupling.
corrections_consumed: no deletion of nonzero coefficient tail
small operator norm used only in deterministic final-matrix spectral algebra
remaining_implication: Force an aggregate receiver when every bounded localization of the physical packet is support-diffuse, spectrally escaping, or strongly boundary-coupled.
